title: 第25章 曹茱萸 我卖身第26章 荒村野狐
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
曹茱萸平日里有多么高冷，整个中山郡谁不知道啊？
可自从认识了沈无名，她就将自己的姿态放得极低，可依旧没有用。
沈无名不搭理她。
“男人嘛，用点手段就是了呗。”中年美妇淡淡道：“以你的姿色，他还有什么可矜持的？”
中年美妇望着自家徒儿的身段，腴美动人，却丝毫不显臃肿，腰臀曲线极为夸张。
就连她一个女人都极为眼热。
“呵呵，人家的娘子是中山四大美人之一，不比我差！”
曹茱萸表现出些许气恼，“而且人家是大家闺秀，不像我在外面抛头露面。”
“谁知道男人怎么想的……而且你在说啥呀，搞得我要卖身一样。”
“我要是敢让你卖身，曹子敬不得打死我。”中年美妇撇了撇嘴。
其他人她或许能拿捏，但曹茱萸背后可是有人的，她爹谁都惹不起。
“不过换句话说，他除了是有妇之夫之外，也不失为一个良配。”
中年美妇意味深长，嘴里轻轻嘀咕，“儒墨双修，而且都是第五境，甚至墨家即将突破第六境！”
“将来最差都是个八境半圣，甚至有可能更进一步，超越墨子……”
“你在嘟囔啥呢？”曹茱萸没有听清楚，追问道。
中年美妇却摇了摇头，儿孙自有儿孙福，她也不可能撺掇曹茱萸去撬寿亭侯府的墙角。
……
沈无名今天走这一趟只是为了赚钱，却没想到，混了一个墨家客卿的位置。
好在得了一块玉佩，还有三万两金票，也就是三十万两银子。
加上曹茱萸给的……不知不觉，自己已经成了千万富豪。

“操，我居然这么有钱。”
沈无名掰着指头算了一下，突然发现自己已经成为了土豪。
历史上唐朝一个中等州府的年税收，也才十万两。
不过这诸子百家发展到今天，金银铜铁开采也变得容易了许多。
商贸也极为发达，倒是不止如此。
但满打满算，一个中山郡的年税收也就五十万两银子左右。
“我这资产，都快比得上中山郡大半年的税收了，可以啊。”
沈无名嘴上虽然在吐槽，但心头还是乐的不行。
有了这么大一笔钱，回头就算不吃软饭，也能够过上不错的日子。
“最重要的是，我的墨家法力又涨了？不是系统大哥，我他妈修儒家的呀。”
沈无名很无奈，他如今的儒家修为才第五境初期，可墨家修为已经到了第五境后期。
再继续下去，墨家修为都快超过儒家修为了。
“我不如转去墨家算了。”
沈无名躺在椅子上，有点摆烂，把玩着手上的玉佩，表情满是无奈。
宋南烛倒是有些疑惑，“当了墨家客卿不好吗？你这么一副表情。”
“你愿意你来，这位置谁稀罕啊？”沈无名翻了个白眼。
正巧曹茱萸走过来，满脸热切地看着那块玉佩，“沈公子，这玉佩能让我看看吗？”
“给给给。”
……
“老裴，你就这么看重沈无名吗？”

后院中，中年美妇慵懒地躺在椅子上，手中罗扇轻轻扇着风。
裴茂嘴角勾起一抹苦涩的笑容，“不是看重，而是……当做秦墨的救星！”
“楚墨的李天罡，以墨家为基础，兼修阴阳家和道家，在天文星象之术上极有造诣。”
“曾于白日引星辰坠落，轰杀蛮夷三千，以杀止杀，成就第五境！”
content_en:
Who in Zhongshan County doesn't know how aloof Cao Juyu is on weekdays?
But ever since she met Shen Wuming, she had lowered her profile to a very low level, but it still didn't work.
Shen Wuming ignored her.
"Men, just use some tricks." The middle-aged beautiful woman said lightly: "With your appearance, what else can he be reserved about?"
The beautiful middle-aged woman looked at her disciple's figure. She was plump and beautiful, but not bloated at all. The curves of her waist and hips were extremely exaggerated.
Even she, a woman, is extremely jealous.
"Haha, my wife is one of the four beauties in Zhongshan, no worse than me!"
Cao Juyu showed a little anger, "Besides, she is a lady, unlike me who is exposed outside."
"Who knows what men think...and what are you talking about? It makes me feel like selling myself."
"If I dare to let you sell yourself, Cao Zijing won't kill me." The beautiful middle-aged woman curled her lips.
She might be able to handle other people, but there was someone behind Cao Zhuyu, and her father couldn't afford to offend anyone.
"But in other words, besides being a married man, he is also a good match."
The middle-aged beautiful woman said meaningfully, and whispered softly, "Confucianism and Mohism are both cultivators, and both are in the fifth realm. Even the Mohists are about to break through to the sixth realm!"
"In the future, at worst, he will be an eighth-level semi-saint, and he may even go one step further and surpass Mozi..."
"What are you muttering about?" Cao Zhuyu asked, not hearing clearly.
But the middle-aged beautiful woman shook her head. Children and grandchildren will have their own blessings, and she would not be able to persuade Cao Juyu to pry into the corner of Shoutinghou Mansion.
…
Shen Wuming made this trip today just to make money, but he didn't expect that he would be a guest of the Mo family.
Fortunately, I got a jade pendant and thirty thousand taels of gold tickets, which is also three hundred thousand taels of silver.
Plus what Cao Juyu gave me... Before I knew it, I had become a multi-millionaire.
"Fuck, I'm actually so rich."
Shen Wuming counted on his fingers and suddenly found that he had become a rich man.
Historically, the annual tax revenue of a medium-sized state capital in the Tang Dynasty was only one hundred thousand taels.
However, these various schools of thought have developed to this day, and mining gold, silver, copper and iron has become much easier.
Commerce and trade are also extremely developed, but that's not all.
But with all calculations, the annual tax revenue of a Zhongshan County is only about 500,000 taels of silver.
"My assets are almost as much as Zhongshan County's tax revenue for half a year, okay."
Although Shen Wuming was complaining, he was still very happy in his heart.
With such a large amount of money, I can still live a good life even if I don't have to live a soft life.
"The most important thing is, my Mohist magic power has increased again? I'm not the big brother of the system, I'm fucking Confucian."
Shen Wuming was helpless. His current Confucian cultivation was at the early stage of the fifth realm, but his Mohist cultivation had already reached the late fifth realm.
If this continues, Mohist cultivation will soon surpass Confucian cultivation.
"I might as well transfer to the Mo family."
Shen Wuming was lying on the chair, a little shabby, playing with the jade pendant in his hand, his expression full of helplessness.
Song Nanzhu was a little confused, "Isn't it good to be a guest of the Mo family? You look like this."
"You come if you want, who cares about this position?" Shen Wuming rolled his eyes.
By chance, Cao Juyu came over and looked at the jade pendant eagerly, "Mr. Shen, can I have a look at this jade pendant?"
"Give, give."
…
"Old Pei, do you think so highly of Shen Wuming?"
In the backyard, a beautiful middle-aged woman was lying lazily on a chair, fanning her hand gently.
A bitter smile appeared on Pei Mao's lips, "It's not that I value him, but... I treat him as Qin Mo's savior!"
"Li Tiangang of Chu Mo, based on Mohism, also studied Yin Yang School and Taoism, and was extremely accomplished in astronomy and astrology."
"I once caused the stars to fall during the day, killed three thousand barbarians, stopped killing with killing, and achieved the fifth realm!"
